csv-missing.hint: the location is relative to the model file

csv-unc.hint: only a human can allow this: pass --allow-network, or point the source at a local path or a mapped drive
csv-unc.message: '\\server\share\orders.csv' is a network path, so it was not read

json_url-off.hint: only a human can allow this: pass --allow-network to the CLI or to `naga mcp`, or grant it in the editor's consent dialog
json_url-off.message: network access is off, so 'https://example.invalid/data.json' was not fetched

sql-env-name.hint: a model file may reference only variables whose names start with NAGASIM_DATA_; the person running the model sets one, for example NAGASIM_DATA_DB_URL, and the source names that
sql-env-name.message: '${PATH}' names an environment variable a model file may not read

sql-env-unset.hint: set NAGASIM_DATA_NOT_SET_ANYWHERE before running, or edit the source's location

sql-no-driver.hint: pip install "nagasim[sql]" (or: pip install sqlalchemy), or use a sqlite source
sql-no-driver.message: a sql source needs the optional sqlalchemy package

sql-off.hint: only a human can allow this: pass --allow-network to the CLI or to `naga mcp`, or grant it in the editor's consent dialog
sql-off.message: network access is off, so 'postgresql://user@host/db' was not connected to

sql-password.hint: write the whole URL as "${NAGASIM_DATA_DB_URL}" and set that environment variable
sql-password.message: source 's': the location embeds a password

sql-sqlite-url.hint: declare it as a "sqlite" source instead, whose path is confined like any other file
sql-sqlite-url.message: 'sqlite:///C:/Windows/win.ini' is a local file, not a network database

sqlite-missing-and-env.hint: the location is relative to the model file

unknown-kind-env.hint: set NAGASIM_DATA_NOT_SET_ANYWHERE before running, or edit the source's location
